newsitem.title: CHINA: First Pac sells Island Dyeing stake.
newsitem.headline: First Pac sells Island Dyeing stake.

text.p: Island Dyeing & Printing Co Ltd said First Pacific Management Services Ltd and First Pacific Land (Hong Kong) Ltd had sold all of their 19.69 million shares or 29.84 percent of the company to independent third parties.
First Pacific Management and First Pacific Land are units of First Pacific Co Ltd.
The company said the shares were sold on June 26 and there were no details of the parties involved.
"The company has not received from any of the purchasers any notification," the statement said.
It said directors nominated by First Pacific -- David Stanley Davies, Godfrey Alexander Blott and David Wong -- had tendered their resignation with effect from June 27.

"The board does not expect any material changes to the business of the company further to (the) disposal and resignation," it said. "The board has not received any request for nomination of new directors to the board."
Island Dyeing was 27.4 percent owned by Itochu Corp and 11.78 percent by Itochu Hong Kong Ltd as in October 1996.
Island Dyeing also said it was in talks with third parties, including parties with a China background, with a view to inject assets into the company in exchange for a stake in the company.
